title: ConductorHaltEntry
description: Schema for a single entry appended to CONDUCTOR_HALT_LOG.md. Informational — used for documentation and future machine parsing.

session_id.description: session_id of the queue entry that triggered this halt.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the halt was emitted.

last_passed.description: session_id of the most recently passed entry before this halt, or 'none'.

queue_position.description: Human-readable position of the halted entry, e.g. '3 of 11'.

resolution_status.description: Whether this halt has been resolved.

failure_context.description: Gate stderr (up to 1000 chars) or sub-agent human_decision_needed text explaining why the halt occurred.

gate_output.description: Gate stdout (up to 500 chars), or '(gate not run)' if the gate was not reached.

resolution_notes.description: Added when the halt is resolved: what action was taken and by whom.
